name: vggface2_test
source: VGGFace2 test split (Cao, Shen, Xie, Parkhi, Zisserman, FG 2018; Oxford VGG, https://www.robots.ox.ac.uk/~vgg/data/vgg_face2/ - the page now states 'The download links for the VGGFace2 dataset are no longer available from this website.'). raw/data/vggface2_test.tar.gz + raw/meta/* from the third-party HF mirror https://huggingface.co/datasets/ProgramComputer/VGGFace2 (raw/README.md is that mirror's card), extracted to test/ (500 identity folders); bb_landmark/ from raw/meta/bb_landmark.tar.gz (official loose boxes + 5 MTCNN-style landmarks).
license: NON-COMMERCIAL RESEARCH ONLY (conservative reading). The HF mirror card states 'license: cc-by-nc-4.0' (its loader script is Apache-2.0 code only). The official page no longer shows licence text (checked 2026-10-11), so the original terms could not be verified here. Images were collected from Google Image Search and remain under their owners' copyright.

counts.used_by: not used in the final E2 run (optional second identity source; loader eval/onen/datasets.py:vggface2_test)

notes: Celebrity identities (training-set overlap likely, as for CelebA). Its 500 test identities are disjoint from the VGGFace2 train identities, not from WebFace/Glint.
